problem_type: Previously unresolved translations concealed invalid compact control copy
symptom: Resolved restored/new action labels expose 25 contract findings across 16 keys in three owned namespaces.
direct_cause: Long explanatory phrases were restored as actual button labels; two labels also violate the established canonical action vocabulary.
class_root: Translation resolution was verified without also exercising the existing control-copy contract against real consumers.
internal_only_reason: The existing control source, GLOSSARY, i18next resources and repository-owned display/source split define this copy invariant. No external model/service capability is assumed or invoked.
invariants: Only 16 existing display keys may change; all other locale values, interpolation variables and raw source/default names stay unchanged.
Chinese visible action labels satisfy existing weight <=4; English <=2 words; canonical GLOSSARY actions are used.
Existing controls, fields, callbacks, permissions, approval and no-resend semantics remain byte-identical.

door_reduction.why_not: Copy values change at the existing locale owners only. Resource registration and each distinct workflow control remain genuine required readers; deleting a control or rewriting its handler would violate the request. Actual AST reads are recorded without pretending pure data definitions are calls.

generality_proof: A focused regression reuses the unchanged real control scanner over every actual control in the three owned namespaces, and checks that each affected key still resolves in both languages. Existing source/hash regressions prove action copy remains outside authored state.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Display-only compact Scene3D actions; canonical defaults stay in their neutral source owner.
Text-model-specific chooser copy with existing full catalog tooltip.
Dreamina CLI update display copy, with original update handler and state untouched.
Invoke the existing unchanged copyOffenders owner over real TSX consumers and resolve every affected key in both languages.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Real existing control still uses the same key, tooltip and onExportFrames callback; only locale label is shortened.
Consumer specifically requires text-model identity and retains its nomi-open-model-catalog event/title.
Same busy/updating conditional and update callback; no CLI is executed here.
No action key reads or edits; existing exact source/prompt/geometry/SSR regressions are rerun.

recurrence.reason: Any new or restored resource can turn a previously unresolved control key into long or inconsistent visible copy.
same_class_scan: Existing copyOffenders and scanControlCopy against all real TSX controls in owned namespaces.
Exact key references and original 21c4de6ea -> 33cd631 locale diff prove task ownership.
Hash all other resolved records and audit all producer/handler/source paths unchanged.

prevention.invariant: Resolved labels in all three owned namespaces obey the unchanged real compact-control contract and retain their real keys/consumers.
prevention.failure_mode: Any new overlong/banned/noncanonical owned control or missing affected locale key fails the focused test.
prevention.strategy: Run the existing AST consumer/real-resource contract after restoring translations; do not modify its parser, bounds or exemptions.

legacy_paths.rationale: All controls, translation keys, fields and handlers remain; only display strings change.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Existing i18next, TypeScript AST parser, Vitest and control-copy checker are retained unchanged.

migration: No stored state migration or key rename. Existing controls resolve shorter display copies; canonical source names and prompt bytes remain independent of locale.
residual_risks: All five focused files pass (105 tests), including existing source/geometry/prompt/hash and SSR cases. This is not whole-repository CI.
The private whole-control scan still contains only coordinator-owned canvasComponents findings because those main-line fixes are not in this private base. Assigned namespaces have zero findings.
Real App/CLI/media/paid flows are deliberately not exercised; full CI remains coordinator-owned.
